title: A reservoir-coupled therapeutic interfering particle can assist immune-mediated HIV-1 post-treatment control: a within-host modeling study
description: Reproducible, self-audited within-host HIV-1 modeling study. Extends Dodd & de Boer (2025) into the latent-reservoir / ART-interruption (ATI) post-treatment-control setting: a therapeutic interfering particle (TIP) coupled to reservoir reactivation is predicted to assist immune-mediated post-treatment control, while a non-coupled TIP recovers the de Boer active-infection limit. Robust across global parameter sampling and three immune models, never backfires, and explained by a derived effective reproduction number. Includes a machine-checkable verification harness (verify_claims.py) and a multi-agent adversarial audit. ILLUSTRATIVE MODELING HYPOTHESIS, not validated experimental or clinical findings.
